description: Local git reads for the work tab (ADR-0190 D3-c, #2855): one command that runs one of eight fixed read-only git commands in a pane's folder and returns parsed fields. For the main window's own webview (label `main`) on the bundled (local) origin only, scoped by webview like pty.json so a child webview does not inherit it. No `remote` entry: a page from the network must never reach it.
